summary: Full regression PJOK Super-App. Backend non-AI: 34/34 pytest pass (classes CRUD, attendance resolve + K3 warning, recap math + zero-session, recap xlsx export with logo+kop, archives CRUD + PDF/DOCX/XLSX export with embedded logo verified via existing suite, journals CRUD, profile+logo upload/get/delete/5MB-reject, malformed-ID 400s). Backend AI: 0/5 endpoints functional — ALL 4 generators (modul-ajar, soal, rubrik, kktp) return 503 and the logo-embedded-export test fails because it depends on generate/modul-ajar. Root cause confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: litellm.RateLimitError 'Budget has been exceeded! Key=davicdi7donc73ch6hh0 Current cost: 1.06853, Max budget: 1.0'. Not a code bug — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhausted. Frontend: Beranda 7-module layout, 4 tabs (Beranda/Kelas/Arsip/Profil), Profil with logo+fields, Arsip filter chips all render on 390x844. New-feature verification: (1) 'Buat Jurnal' button on each session card at /class/[id] opens /jurnal with auto-prefilled form — tanggal=2026-01-15, kelas=TEST UI 8A, materi=Sepak Bola, kegiatan='Materi: Sepak Bola. Kehadiran — H:1 · S:1 · I:0 · A:0 · K3:0.' ✓. (2) Excel export icon in Rekap header triggers window.open to /api/classes/{id}/recap/export; endpoint returns valid 6789-byte xlsx (verified via `file`). (3) Logo-embed in xlsx/docx/pdf covered by existing iteration-1 passing test. No deprecated expo packages. No React Native issues. Not able to UI-verify AI generators due to budget exhaustion.

critical.issue: All 4 AI generators return 503 'Layanan AI sedang sibuk, coba lagi sebentar lagi.' Backend log shows underlying error: 'litellm.RateLimitError: Budget has been exceeded! Key=davicdi7donc73ch6hh0 (sk-...RHGA) Current cost: 1.06853, Max budget: 1.0'. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env is over its budget cap. All 4 AI features (Modul 1,2,3,5) and the auto-save-to-archive flows that depend on them are non-functional until the key is topped up / rotated. This also breaks TestLogoEmbeddedExport.

minor.issue: server.py generate_markdown masks the underlying LLM exception by raising 503 with a generic Indonesian message. For debuggability, consider including err.__class__.__name__ (or RateLimitError-specific message like 'Kuota AI habis') so the caller/user can distinguish 'budget exhausted' from 'temporarily busy'.

rca_of_issue: All 4 AI generator endpoints and the dependent LogoEmbeddedExport test fail with HTTP 503. Backend ERROR log at /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log shows: 'litellm.RateLimitError: RateLimitError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Key=davicdi7donc73ch6hh0 (sk-...RHGA) Current cost: 1.06853, Max budget: 1.0'. Reproduction: `curl -X POST https://mbg-builder.preview.emergentagent.com/api/generate/rubrik -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jenjang":"SMP","cabang":"Senam"}'` -> 503 + body 'Layanan AI sedang sibuk, coba lagi sebentar lagi.' Mitigation: rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env (or increase budget) and `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. Optional dev-UX improvement: surface quota-exceeded as a distinct message in generate_markdown exception handler.
